```{python}
import yaml
import os
from IPython.display import display, Markdown, HTML

with open("./items.yaml") as f:
    raw_items = yaml.safe_load(f)
    items = sorted(raw_items, key=lambda x: (x['dates'][0]['year'], x['dates'][0]['month'], x['title']), reverse=True)
```

## Virtual Reality and Web Projects

Projects concerning Virtual Reality, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and SQL. VR projects are conducted with <a href="https://www.oculus.com/quest/" target="_blank">Meta Quest platforms</a> and programmed in C#/C Sharp with <a href="https://unity.com/" target="_blank">Unity</a>.

```{python}
# Get only those related to VR and Web
vr_projects = [p for p in items if p['subcategory'] in ['VR','Web']]

contents = "<div class='portfolio'>"
for item in vr_projects:
    # Get the root url of this item
    root_url = os.path.join('.', item['id'])
    thumb_url = os.path.join(root_url, 'thumbnail.png')
    contents += f"<a href='portfolio/{item['id']}' class='portfolio_item'>"
    contents += "<div class='portfolio_item_contents'>"
    contents += f"<div class='portfolio_item_thumbnail'><img src='{thumb_url}' /></div>"
    contents += f"<h3>{item['title']}</h3>"
    contents += "<p>Click to read more</p>"
    contents += "</div>"
    contents += "</a>"
contents += "</div>"
display(HTML(contents))
```
